name: Seal of Alysrazor rank 1 applies its Intellect buff for 30 min (#4499)
contract: #4499: Seal of Alysrazor rank 1 (800196) reportedly gives no Intellect +2 buff. DBC shows a plain SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA (aura 29 MOD_STAT, misc 3 Intellect, BP 1 -> value 2) with DurationIndex 30 (1800000 ms = 30 min), no script binding and no Pyromancer C++ reference, so the native path should deliver it. #5597 already fixed the spell being stripped on level-up (added {24, 5, 800196} to ClassSpells); this scenario retests the reported symptom end to end at the reporter's level 8: learn, cast on the ally, and assert the aura, its +2 amount and its 30-min duration.
